text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I got it~♪ Tra-la-la, Chan won 
it all~♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It's the ‘Ma-chan in 1st Place’ song. I 
could sing it on an endless loop right 
now."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Because today's star is Machan. Her 
cuteness and strength will boost her fame 
even further. Smooth sailing all the way."

This might lead to inquiries from various 
places about making merchandise. I should 
prepare a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We're heading straight to the merch shop 
right away. To cook up some fabulous merch 
ideas.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That's true. ...For Chan-Me to make 
such a mistake, I must deeply reflect.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan puts on a scary face during races. 
Chan doesn't know if her cuteness came 
through properly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why, Trainer, please get the 
camera ready."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking photos for her... I resolved 
not to let my guard down for what comes 
next.
